lines.en: Can I borrow your car for a month?
I already lent you my car.
Do you not know where my car is?
Oh, I'm so sick of the third degree.
except that I live in constant fear for my life.
So I guess it's time to do the mature thing
and have someone else dump it for me.
I just heard that you and Traeger
I mean, we're already planning on having a baby together.
We're not quite a couple, but--
You say that about every girl you date.
Seriously, Mona Lisa is legit insane.
She once jumped out of a moving car
to buy a Nicki Minaj poster.
Can you break up with her for me?
I'm not going to dump a girl for you.
I'll give you that Chanel blanket of mine you love so much.
Won't you do it for free?
